# Advizen Consulting

> Advizen Consulting LLC is an advisory firm in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. It advises foreign and local companies entering and operating in Uzbekistan on tax, law, accounting, HR and payroll, funding, M&A and due diligence, and runs managed services such as entity management, Employer of Record, payroll, work permits and a virtual office. Work is coordinated by one partner, in English, Russian or Uzbek.

- [Human resources](https://www.advizenco.com/expertise/hr): recruitment, HR outsourcing, HR audits

- [Due diligence](https://www.advizenco.com/expertise/due-diligence): tax, legal and financial review before an investment or acquisition

## Track record

Fifteen engagements led by Advizen advisers are on record (client names withheld), including tax, accounting and customs structuring of a nuclear power plant construction with a budget above $10 billion, due diligence and holding structuring for a Chinese energy group's $2B+ Uzbek operations, 80+ company registrations, 30+ tax and legal due diligences, and local consulting on banking, capital markets and Islamic finance legislation.

## Key Facts — Uzbekistan Business Environment

- Corporate profit tax rate: 15%
- VAT rate: 12%
- Personal income tax rate: 12% (flat)
- Social tax (employer): 12%
- LLC (MChJ) registration timeline: 1–3 business days via e-government portal
- Full operational readiness (bank account, tax registration): 1–3 weeks
- 100% foreign ownership permitted in the vast majority of sectors
- Law on Foreign Investment guarantees profit repatriation and protection against nationalisation
- Withholding tax on payments to non-residents without a permanent establishment: 10% on dividends and interest, 20% on royalties and most other income (Tax Code, Art. 353)
- Special Economic Zones (SEZs): Navoiy FEZ, Urgut FEZ, Jizzakh SEZ and others, with their own tax and customs incentives
- Crypto/fintech licensing body: NAPP (National Agency for Perspective Projects)
